CNS Tap Test is an adaptation of the Finger Tap Test (FTT) or Finger Oscillation Test (FOT) which  is used  to measure the status of the central nervous system (CNS), and is one of the most commonly used tests in neuropsychology, because of its simplicity and reliability, and because it generates relevant data about fine motor control, which is based on motor speed as well as kinesthetic and visual-motor ability.

The application should be used on a regular basis to determine an athlete’s baseline. If the CNS Tap Test result is elevated it is suitable for a  maximum effort or a heavy lifting day. If the CNS Tap Test result is lower than average it may indicate CNS fatigue and impending sickness, injury or over-training.

Both hands should be tested on a regular basis in a consistent environment, typically every morning on waking. The procedure for testing is:

 - Rest hand palm down on the heel of the hand on a flat surface
 - Tapping is done with the index (pointing finger), and all other fingers remain on the flat surface
 - The timer starts with the first tap
 - When the timer expires no further taps will be accepted
 - The result can either be saved or discarded.

Multiple samples can be saved per day.

Quit For Health is a motivational app to help those looking to quit or stay clean of smoking, soda, alcohol, chewing tobacco, and/or junk food. 

Quit For Health will show you real-time statistics on your progress to help you stay strong and motivated. By seeing your progress, it may give you that extra push to follow through! Some examples include:

Smoking: 
- How many years, days, and hours since your last cigarette
- How many cigarettes you have avoided
- How much tar you have avoided
- How much money you have saved

Soda:
- How many years, days, and hours since your last soda
- How much sugar or aspartame you have avoided
- How much money you have saved

Alcohol:
- How many years, days, and hours since your last drink
- How much money you have saved

Chewing Tobacco:
- How many years, days, and hours since your last chew
- How much nicotine you have avoided
- How much money you have saved

Junk Food:
- How many years, days, and hours since your last junk food
- How much money you have saved

Reach milestones one by one as time passes that will continue to encourage you to reach the next goal.

Quit For Health is customized to you. You can set if you're ready to quit now, or whether you intend to do so at a later time. Set your own goals by writing specific notes and/or uploading photos that are motivational to you. Easily reference back to them during the tough times.

Reach out to fellow quitters for help in our community section. Being able to communicate with other members can give you that motivational push you need when craving.

Set warning times for your usually craving times and we will send you a reminder to stay strong and keep you on track.

We will continue to update the app to make it better and easier for you based on feedback we receive. Be sure to always update the app regularly to take benefit of all the features. 

Download Quit For Health now to start your path on a longer, healthier life!

With the Kelee® meditation app you can do this 5-minute meditation anywhere with just one tap on your iPhone or iPad. Ron W. Rathbun, Founder of Kelee meditation walks you through this practice just as he does individuals from all walks of life.

Within this app there are 7 places to go.

1. Listen to the guided 5-minute Kelee meditation practice by Ron W. Rathbun. We recommend to meditate once in the morning and once in the evening for best results.
2. Read the instructions on how to do this meditation based on stillness of mind.
3. Watch a short video on how to do this practice.
4. Listen to Daniel Lee, M.D. explain the Kelee phenomenon.
5. Write in your journal after your meditation practice.
6. Contact websites
7. If you would like further information, we provide links to our ebook/books within the app.

The hallmark of Kelee meditation is that, things that used to bother you, no longer do. A study at UCSD Medical Center shows Kelee meditation decreases stress, anxiety and depression.
